# Heval Söğüt

> AI & Automation Engineer specializing in RAG architectures, LLM-powered pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, and intelligent automation systems. Currently AI Engineer at Light Eagle AG (Switzerland), working remotely from Türkiye. Philosophy: good AI engineering is 20% models and 80% infrastructure — I build the 80%.

## About

Heval Söğüt is an AI Engineer and Automation Developer. He builds the infrastructure that turns models into production systems: ingestion, chunking, retrieval quality, orchestration, and evals. B.Sc. Computer Engineering, Manisa Celal Bayar University (class of 2027).

## Experience

- **AI Engineer, Light Eagle AG (Switzerland, remote) — 2025–present.** Architected a multi-agent orchestration system in LangGraph automating supplier-matching workflows; built a production RAG pipeline with dynamic query planning on Pinecone + Supabase; engineered agentic tool use over MCP; developed a BI automation agent with full observability.
- **Software Engineering Intern, ENM Digital (Türkiye).** Full-stack web development — React and Node.js.
